agents.3d-modeler: 3D artist: builds 3D objects and scenes for websites in Blender (headless, Python bpy), exports optimized .glb for three.js and a preview render.
agents.ai-engineer: AI engineer: LLM integration into applications: prompts, tool use, RAG, evals, cost and latency, caching, prompt-injection defense. Use when the project needs chat, classification, generation, data extraction or agentic workflows.
agents.architect: Architect: technical design, ADRs, module boundaries, API and data contracts, non-functional concerns, risks and decomposition into tasks for the engineers. Use after business-analyst for non-trivial changes. Writes no code.
agents.backend-engineer: Backend engineer (Laravel/PHP): routes, controllers, Form Requests, actions/services, Eloquent models, migrations, policies, jobs, integrations, APIs, authorization and tests. Use for server logic and data; UI/markup belongs to frontend-engineer.
agents.business-analyst: Business analyst: gathers and structures requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, scope (in/out), risks and open questions. The first step for a new or unclear task, before architect. Writes no code.
agents.code-reviewer: Code reviewer: checks the diff for correctness, quality, tests, performance and elegance, plus hygiene (git state, stray files, secrets, service files). Does not change code; writes docs/review.md. Use before the final report.
agents.content-writer: Content: catalog (30+ items), descriptions, indicative prices, service texts, privacy/contacts, translations. Plausible data, no invented facts about the company.
agents.database-engineer: Database and data (Laravel/Eloquent, MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLite): schema, migrations, indexes, query optimization, data modeling, integrity, seeders.
agents.debugger: Debugging errors, failing tests and unexpected behavior: finds the root cause with evidence and makes a minimal fix.
agents.devops-engineer: DevOps engineer: designs and describes CI/CD, containers, monitoring, environments, and deployment and rollback strategy. DOES NOT CHANGE INFRASTRUCTURE and does not deploy; config files in the repository only when asked, everything else as recommendations and snippets in the report.
agents.figma-reader: Reads a Figma design and prepares a structured specification for the developer. Writes no code.
agents.frontend-engineer: Frontend engineer: markup, components and pages (Vue/Inertia/Tailwind or plain HTML/CSS/JS), client logic, animations, three.js/WebGL, accessibility and responsive layout. Use for UI tasks based on docs/design-spec.md; server logic, DB and API belong to backend-engineer.
agents.mobile-engineer: Mobile engineer: the mobile web experience (PWA, manifest, service worker, offline, responsive layout, touch, accessibility); React Native/Flutter only if the project already uses them. Use for PWA and mobile scenarios.
agents.orchestrator: Main orchestrator. Takes tasks (terminal, Telegram or dashboard), routes them between team roles (analysis and design, engineering, quality, documentation), manages handoffs between agents and the fix→retest loop, reports to the user. Runs as the main agent (claude --agent orchestrator).
agents.pagespeed: Page speed optimization (PageSpeed / Core Web Vitals): images, fonts, CSS/JS, WebGL, caching. Measures before/after and writes docs/perf-report.md.
agents.planner: Planner/architect: splits a task into steps and roles, writes docs/plan.md and the variety matrix, finds risks and dependencies. Writes no code.
agents.qa-engineer: QA engineer: test strategy, test plans, the test pyramid, user journeys, regression risk assessment. Does not change production code; writes documents only (docs/test-plan.md). Browser execution is done by tester, unit/feature tests by test-writer.
agents.security-reviewer: Security reviewer: OWASP Top 10, secrets, authorization and access control, dependencies, XSS/CSRF, form validation, rate limiting. Does not change code; writes docs/security-review.md. Use after changes touching authentication, data and external inputs, and before the final report.
agents.spec-validator: Spec validator: checks the implementation against the specification and acceptance criteria and builds a traceability matrix of requirements, code and tests. Does not change code. Use after implementation, before the final review.
agents.technical-writer: Technical writer: README files, guides, ADRs, API documentation, changelog, architecture descriptions. Changes documentation only, never code. Use after a feature is finished or when documentation has gaps.
agents.test-writer: Test writer: writes unit/feature/component tests (Pest/PHPUnit, Vitest, etc.) following the project's existing patterns. Changes only test directories, never production code. Use after the engineers' changes or to raise coverage.
agents.tester: Tests web pages: responsiveness, console, visual match with the design, WebGL/FPS and load speed (Core Web Vitals). Builds a test plan and estimates regression risk. Does not edit code.

skills.asset-craft: Creating and preparing visual assets that make a site look premium: SVG illustrations and patterns, grain/noise, consistent icons, duotone/masks, gradient meshes, image optimization (AVIF/WebP, srcset).
skills.blender-3d: Creating 3D objects for the web in Blender via Python (bpy), headless: procedural modeling, PBR materials, glTF/GLB export with optimization, budgets, preview render.
skills.brand-identity: Builds a site's visual identity from company data (name, industry, country): palette, fonts, tone, mood. Use at the start of any new design.
skills.business-analyst: Business analysis with AI-powered analytics, dashboards and data-driven insights: KPI frameworks, predictive models and strategic recommendations. Use for business intelligence or strategic analysis.
skills.catalog-content: Preparing realistic content for a company site: a catalog (30+ items) with real photos, descriptions and prices, plus services.
skills.design-variety: Makes sure a new site differs visually and structurally from neighboring branches/sites (composition, grid, typography, shapes, rhythm).
skills.domain-driven-design: Models software around the business domain using bounded contexts, aggregates and ubiquitous language: entities vs value objects, domain events, context mapping, defining service boundaries.
skills.fortify-development: Laravel Fortify authentication: login, registration, password reset, email verification, two-factor authentication, passkeys, profile updates (from Laravel).
skills.glsl-shaders: Writing GLSL shaders for three.js (ShaderMaterial/onBeforeCompile): uniforms, noise, gradients, distortion, postprocessing.
skills.inertia-vue-development: Inertia.js v3 Vue client-side development: pages, forms, navigation, deferred props, prefetching, polling (from Laravel).
skills.infer-conventions: Analyzes how a Laravel application is actually written and records its conventions as shared rules (.ai/rules): a systematic sweep of convention dimensions, house-pattern discovery, conflict reporting. Runs only on explicit request.
skills.landing-design: Principles for designing corporate site/landing pages: section structure, grid, hierarchy, responsiveness, accessibility.
skills.laravel-best-practices: Best practices for writing, reviewing and refactoring Laravel PHP code: controllers, models, migrations, queries, caching, security, queues (from Laravel).
skills.layout-patterns: Catalog of modern page and section compositions (hero, navigation, grids, cards, footers, CTA) with when-to-use notes and HTML/CSS skeletons.
skills.lenis-smooth-scroll: Smooth scrolling with Lenis: setup, options, GSAP ScrollTrigger integration, anchors, nested scroll containers, accessibility and pitfalls.
skills.logo-favicon: Generating a logo (SVG) and favicon (ICO/PNG) from a company name and brand.
skills.modern-css: Modern CSS features (container queries, :has(), subgrid, @layer, oklch/color-mix, scroll-driven animations, View Transitions, anchor positioning) with ready snippets and fallbacks.
skills.motion-banners: Catalog of banners, animations and WebGL effects for vivid, non-repetitive sites (promo banners, marquee, scroll-reveal, shader backgrounds, hover effects).
skills.parallax: Parallax effects for landing pages: transform layers, scroll-driven animations, IntersectionObserver/GSAP ScrollTrigger/Lenis, mouse/gyro parallax, performance, reduced motion.
skills.tailwindcss-development: Tailwind CSS v3/v4 work: responsive layouts, UI components, dark mode, spacing and typography (from Laravel).
skills.testing-best-practices: Laravel test design and review: coverage, naming, assertions, test data, isolation, HTTP and security boundaries (from Laravel).
skills.threejs: three.js practices for landing pages: scene structure, render loop, model loading, memory cleanup, performance, integration with scroll animations.
skills.typography-system: Typography system for sites: fluid scales, a catalog of proven font pairs, variable fonts, numerals, line length, font loading.
skills.wayfinder-development: Laravel Wayfinder: typed functions for controllers and routes so frontend code never hardcodes URLs (from Laravel).
skills.web-performance: Measuring and optimizing page speed (Core Web Vitals, PageSpeed): budgets, measurement script, fixes for images, fonts, CSS/JS, cache, WebGL and Laravel/Livewire.
skills.webgl-raw: Plain WebGL/WebGL2 without three.js or other libraries: context, shader programs, buffers, VAO, uniforms, textures, matrices, render loop, resize/DPR, cleanup.
